free.title: How much does it cost?
free.content: Keirost is open source: you can install it on your own servers without paying for licences. If you prefer not to deal with anything, it can also be offered as a hosted service.

data.title: Where is my data?
data.content: Each company has its own space in the database, separate from the others. You can export all of it whenever you want, with its attachments.

companies.title: Can I manage several companies?
companies.content: Yes. The same user can belong to several companies and switch between them; each one with its own data, permissions and branding.

mobile.title: Does it work on mobile?
mobile.content: Yes. The whole app adapts to mobile: clock in, check stock, scan codes or record a delivery with the customer's signature.

extend.title: Can I adapt it to my business?
extend.content: With plugins you can add fields, screens, document types and automations. And themes change colours, typography and the whole look.

ai.title: What does the assistant do?
ai.content: It answers questions about your data, prepares documents and suggests actions. It only sees what your user can see, and asks for confirmation before changing anything.
